@@ -1,13 +1,14 @@
 # Makefile for Java workspaces.
 #
-# Provides a normalized interface for Maven/Gradle builds and native workspace tasks.
+# Provides a normalized interface for Maven/Gradle builds and native
+# workspace tasks.
 #
 # Usage:
 #   make          # build the Java project
 #   make build    # run Maven or Gradle build
-# make test # run Maven or Gradle tests
+#   make test     # run Maven or Gradle tests
 #   make clean    # remove generated output
-# make notes # show the notes directory path
+#   make notes    # show the notes directory path
 #
 MAVEN ?= mvn
 GRADLE ?= gradle
@@ -17,20 +18,36 @@ CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
 all: build
 
 build: ## Build the Java project using Maven or Gradle.
-    @if [ -f pom.xml ]; then $(MAVEN) package; elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then $(GRADLE) build;
-    else echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; exit 1; fi
+	@if [ -f pom.xml ]; then \
+		$(MAVEN) package; \
+	elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then \
+		$(GRADLE) build; \
+	else \
+		echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; \
+		exit 1; \
+	fi
 
 test: ## Run Java tests using Maven or Gradle.
-    @if [ -f pom.xml ]; then $(MAVEN) test; elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then $(GRADLE) test; else
-    echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; exit 1; fi
+	@if [ -f pom.xml ]; then \
+		$(MAVEN) test; \
+	elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then \
+		$(GRADLE) test; \
+	else \
+		echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; \
+		exit 1; \
+	fi
 
 clean: ## Remove generated output files.
-	$(MAVEN) clean || true
-	$(GRADLE) clean || true
+	@if [ -f pom.xml ]; then \
+		$(MAVEN) clean; \
+	fi
+	@if [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then \
+		$(GRADLE) clean; \
+	fi
 	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)"
 
 notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
 	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
 
 help: ## Show available targets.
-    @printf "Available targets:\n build test clean notes\n"
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test clean notes\n"

@@ -1,14 +1,14 @@
 # Makefile for Python workspaces.
 #
-# Provides a normalized interface for Python venv setup, package management,
-# and native workspace tasks.
+# Provides a normalized interface for Python environment setup, package
+# management, and native workspace tasks.
 #
 # Usage:
 #   make          # install dependencies and validate the environment
 #   make build    # run any project-specific build step (if defined)
-# make test # run unit tests
+#   make test     # run unit tests
 #   make clean    # remove generated artifacts
-# make notes # show the notes directory path
+#   make notes    # show the notes directory path
 #
 PYTHON ?= python3
 PIP ?= pip
@@ -17,9 +17,14 @@ CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
 .PHONY: all build test clean notes help
 all: build
 
-build: ## Install dependencies using pip and run the build step if available.
-	$(PIP) install -r requirements.txt
-	@echo "No additional Python build step defined."
+build: ## Install dependencies using pip if a requirements file is present.
+	@if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then \
+		$(PIP) install -r requirements.txt; \
+	elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then \
+		$(PYTHON) -m pip install .; \
+	else \
+		echo "No Python dependency manifest found; skipping install."; \
+	fi
 
 test: ## Run Python tests if a test suite exists.
 	$(PYTHON) -m pytest
@@ -31,4 +36,4 @@ notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
 	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
 
 help: ## Show available targets.
-    @printf "Available targets:\n build test clean notes\n"
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test clean notes\n"

@@ -33,6 +33,4 @@ notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
 	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
 
 help: ## Show available targets.
-	@printf "Available targets:
-  build test check clean notes
-"
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test check clean notes\n"

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 # Makefile for TypeScript/Node.js workspaces.
 #
-# Provides a normalized interface for package manager commands and native workspace tasks.
+# Provides a normalized interface for package manager commands and native
+# workspace tasks.
 #
 # Usage:
 #   make          # install dependencies and build
@@ -19,13 +20,30 @@ CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
 all: build
 
 build: ## Build the project using the detected package manager.
-	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then 		$(BUN) install && $(BUN) run build; 	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then 		$(PNPM) install && $(PNPM) run build; 	elif [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then 		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; 	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then 		$(YARN) install && $(YARN) build; 	else 		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; 	fi
+	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+		$(BUN) install && $(BUN) run build; \
+	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then \
+		$(PNPM) install && $(PNPM) run build; \
+	elif [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then \
+		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; \
+	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then \
+		$(YARN) install && $(YARN) run build; \
+	else \
+		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; \
+	fi
 
 test: ## Run tests using the detected package manager.
-	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then 		$(BUN) test; 	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then 		$(PNPM) test; 	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then 		$(YARN) test; 	else 		$(NPM) test; 	fi
+	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+		$(BUN) test; \
+	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then \
+		$(PNPM) test; \
+	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then \
+		$(YARN) test; \
+	else \
+		$(NPM) test; \
+	fi
 
 clean: ## Remove generated output files.
-	if [ -f bun.lockb ]; then $(BUN) run clean; fi
 	rm -rf node_modules dist "$(CLEAN_DIR)"
 
 notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
